pages.text: Mumu's Grandma gave them five rice cakes, round and soft. Taro and Mumu sat on the porch.
"Five cakes! Let's share them." "Okay!" They spread out a leaf.
One, two. Two, one. Each ate two cakes. But one was left.
Taro did not eat the last one. He wanted Mumu to have it. "I'm full."
Mumu did not eat it either, wanting Taro to have it. "I'm full, too."
They looked at the leaf. The single cake still sat there. Neither touched it.
They talked about other things. The cake stayed where it was, slowly drying in the sun.
Ants came in a line, heading for the cake. "Oh, oh, oh!"
Both reached out at once. The cake broke in half. "Half each!"
Each ate a half. The ants carried off the crumbs. Neither friend was full at all.
